IPageIUserProfile.description: Paginated response for IUserProfile list/search APIs, referencing user_profiles table conforming to all privacy, accessibility, and multicultural support policies per requirements.

id.description: Profile record PK (user_profiles.id), non-editable, unique per user.

user_id.description: Associated user's ID, enforcing 1:1 mapping for privacy preservation (Core.user_profiles.user_id).

oneOf.description: Preferred locale/language-region for this user (user_profiles.locale_id).
Display name, as provided by user or profile onboarding (user_profiles.full_name). Nullable for enhanced privacy or pseudonymous users.

full_name.description: Display name, as provided by user or profile onboarding (user_profiles.full_name). Nullable for enhanced privacy or pseudonymous users.

oneOf.description: URI for avatar, profile image, or digital representation (user_profiles.avatar_url). Supports up to 80KB, for A11Y/multicultural teams.

avatar_url.description: URI for avatar, profile image, or digital representation (user_profiles.avatar_url). Supports up to 80KB, for A11Y/multicultural teams.

oneOf.description: User's configured timezone preference, improves UX and supports accessiblity/ localization (user_profiles.timezone).

timezone.description: User's configured timezone preference, improves UX and supports accessiblity/ localization (user_profiles.timezone).

oneOf.description: Optional short bio or intro for public/personalization flows (user_profiles.bio).

bio.description: Optional short bio or intro for public/personalization flows (user_profiles.bio).

oneOf.description: Serialized accessibility preferences (user_profiles.a11y_prefs). Used to drive WCAG/a11y modules and analytics; never exposed directly for tracking.

a11y_prefs.description: Serialized accessibility preferences (user_profiles.a11y_prefs). Used to drive WCAG/a11y modules and analytics; never exposed directly for tracking.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of profile entity (Core.user_profiles.created_at), for audit and compliance workflows.

updated_at.description: Update timestamp of profile data (user_profiles.updated_at), audit/integrity/correction event.

IUserProfile.description: Formal user profile entity per Core.user_profiles model, 1:1 mapping with user. Implements all multicultural, accessibility, and privacy requirements from the analysis. Exposes only business/auditable fields. Personalization, localization, and evidence are first-class citizens for AI-native and audit/explainability scenarios.

user_id.description: UUID for user who owns this profile, 1:1 relationship (Core.user_profiles.user_id). Required, links to registered user entity.

locale_id.description: Locale UUID for user's preferred i18n or a11y experience (user_profiles.locale_id). May be omitted for default locale.

full_name.description: User's complete display name to be shown in profile, analytics, or notification flows. May be omitted for pseudonymous/anonymous users.

avatar_url.description: Optional URI for profile image/avatar in compliance with accessibility/media handling policies (user_profiles.avatar_url).

timezone.description: Timezone code/identifier for localization. Used for accessibility and multicultural context (user_profiles.timezone).

a11y_prefs.description: Serialized accessibility preference set for WCAG/a11y enforcement modules.

IUserProfile.ICreate.description: Payload to create a user profile entry, implementing multicultural, accessibility, and evidence-based onboarding as per the user_profiles table in the Core schema.

locale_id.description: Updates the locale/language reference for user (user_profiles.locale_id).

full_name.description: Update user's full display name for personalization or personalization-compliant context.

avatar_url.description: Update avatar URL/media ref for user's profile image.

timezone.description: Update user's timezone (e.g., for activity logs, notifications, calendar, analytics).

bio.description: Update personal description or short intro text as per business or audit requirements.

a11y_prefs.description: Update accessibility settings, a11y/assistive preference payload. AI-driven and WCAG-compliant flows can update this for user adjustment.

IUserProfile.IUpdate.description: Payload for partial/multi-field updates of user profile entry (user_profiles table). Implements audit chain, accessibility, multicultural, and personalization correction as per requirements. Record PK/user_id is path-level and not here.

id.description: Profile ID that was soft-deleted (user_profiles.id).

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when profile was marked deleted. Compliant with evidence-preservation, regulatory, right-to-be-forgotten protocols per requirements.

IUserProfile.ISoftDelete.description: Confirmation for soft-delete operation against user profile. References evidence fields, for compliance, audit chain, and regulatory workflows as per Core schema.

IOrganization.IRequest.description: Structure for querying organizations with advanced filtering, search, and pagination. Features mapping to requirements for multi-tenant, B2B, and analytic flows.

IPageIOrganization.description:
Paginated list result for organizations. Implements IPage<T> contract, returning list of organizations and required pagination metadata.

Maps system extensibility and scalability requirements—large B2B environments, analytical workspace management.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the organization entity. Maps to organizations.id in Prisma and ERD schema.

Aligns with multi-tenant/business boundaries for users, roles, compliance.

name.description:
Display/legal name for the organization. Must be unique. Reference for UI, audits, and compliance reporting.

Organization code, unique/slug pattern. Used for onboarding, programmatic integrations, and B2B partner mapping.

IOrganization.description:
Core organization/business entity for multi-tenant, B2B, and compliance.

Pulls from organizations table in Core Prisma schema—see extensive audit/commentary. Maps legal/business, security, compliance, and operational boundaries. All fields atomic (3NF/ERD compliance).

name.description:
Display/legal name for the new organization.

code.description:
Machine/slug code for the new organization. Used for programmatic onboarding/integrations.

Reference: Organizations.code column in Core Prisma schema. Uniqueness strictly enforced.

IOrganization.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new organization entity. Implements B2B onboarding, partner/tenant management, compliance audit requirements—see Core schema and requirement analysis.

name.description: Optional updated name for the organization. Must comply with legal requirements for business entity naming, uniqueness.

code.description: Optional updated code/slug. Strict validation/uniqueness enforced; changes must not break systemic B2B partner integrations or audit trails.

IOrganization.IUpdate.description: Payload for updating allowed fields on an organization. System restricts changes to avoid crossing legal/auditable history boundaries. See requirements on compliance evidence and B2B systems.

page.description: Current page number for paginated role list requests. Implements API best practices for role management/admin environments.

limit.description: Records per page, supporting API burst-guard, performance scaling, and analytics for large organization/role sets.

name.description:

Referenced in admin onboarding, compliance, permission reviews.

IRole.IRequest.description: Query object for retrieving/filtering roles with advanced search, pagination, and multi-tenant contexts. Maps to requirements for RBAC, compliance, and partner onboarding (see Core schema, requirements analysis documents).

data.description: Array of role records from role management query.

IPageIRole.description: Paginated role response container. Fulfills scalability and admin management requirements for RBAC, multi-tenant, and partner systems.

id.description: Primary key identifier for the role. Direct mapping to roles.id field in Prisma schema. Used in permission/RBAC enforcement, audit, and API assignment controls.

organization_id.description: Organization to which this role belongs. Allows for organization-scoped RBAC and regulatory separation. Derived from roles.organization_id field in schema and ERD.

name.description: Human-friendly display name for the role (e.g., 'admin', 'manager', 'customer'). Used in UI, policy management, and compliance evidence reporting.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update. Used for compliance, permission change history, and onboarding review.

IRole.description:
Normalized role definition—holds all authority, policy, and audit fields for RBAC, compliance, and onboarding. Each record is atomic per ERD/DB best practice.

Fields align with Core Prisma schema and requirements (see section on role boundaries, extensibility, evidence preservation).

organization_id.description:
Required unique identifier of the organization context in which to create the role.

Referenced from: roles.organization_id in schema. Ensures audit trace and B2B isolation.

name.description: Display name for new role (e.g., 'admin', 'staff'). Enforced for uniqueness, compliance, and onboarding workflows.

code.description: Machine slug for the role. Used for programmatic RBAC mapping/automation. Reference: roles.code in schema. Must be unique within the org.

description.description: Optional human readable explanation of the role context. Assists in onboarding, evidence management, and permission documentation.

IRole.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new role entity. Enforcement of RBAC, onboarding, and compliance evidence policies (see requirements analysis, Prisma schema roles table, ERD).

name.description: Optional updated role display name. Changes subject to audit and compliance trace. Must remain unique within organization context.

code.description: Optional updated role code. Machine-processed for RBAC/automation, strict uniqueness per org enforced.

description.description: Optional updated description for the role's authority/business context. Serves onboarding, evidence, and future extensibility.

IRole.IUpdate.description: Payload for mutating valid updatable fields on a Role. On mutation, audit records must capture change context (see compliance, audit preservation in requirements analysis and Prisma schema).

page.description: Page number for paginated session record queries. Implements best practices for monitoring, security, and analytics at scale.

limit.description: Page size (records per query) for session search. Default and max limits driven by scalability requirements and SLAs.

user_id.description: Optional user filter (sessions for a single user). Enables analytics, session monitoring, fraud investigation as in security requirements.

expires_before.description: Session expiration upper bound filter. Used for analytics, session lifecycle enforcement, and monitoring.

expires_after.description: Filter for sessions with expiration timestamp after a certain date/time. Enables advanced session management, fraud analytics, and evidence export.

device_fingerprint.description: Optional filter for sessions initiated with a specific device (multi-device analytics, fraud capture, a11y).

ip.description: Optional search by IP address captured at login/session start. Supports regulatory, forensic, and anomaly detection workflows per requirements.

ISession.IRequest.description: Request query payload for session listing/search. Implements robust security, analytics, and evidence requirements for session management (see Core schema and security requirements).

data.description: List of session records matching request filters.

IPageISession.description: Paginated response container for session management queries. Implements requirements for scalable, secure, and evidence-grade monitoring.

ISession.description:
Represents an individual user session, as modeled in the `sessions` table of the Core schema.

A session tracks authentication, user context, device information, and lifecycle for login, audit, and security analytics. Bound to MFA, privacy protections, and session/logout evidence. See `sessions` in Prisma schema.

id.description:
The unique session identifier. See `sessions.id` in the Prisma schema.

Provides secure, non-reusable assignment by system for every login session.

user_id.description:
References the user who owns this session. See `sessions.user_id`.

Enforces 1:N relationship with users for account/session management.

token.description:
Opaque authentication token for this session. See `sessions.token` in the schema.

Never exposes raw passwords; used for cookie or client-auth context.

expires_at.description:
Timestamp for session expiry. See `sessions.expires_at` column.

Used for session management and regulatory compliance (idle/absolute timeout).

oneOf.description:
Optional device fingerprint for risk/MFA/analytics. See `sessions.device_fingerprint`.

Null if unknown; enables fraud and anomaly detection.

device_fingerprint.description:
Optional device fingerprint for risk/MFA/analytics. See `sessions.device_fingerprint`.

Null if unknown; enables fraud and anomaly detection.

oneOf.description:
Last known IP address for the session (tracked for security). See `sessions.ip`.

May be IPv4 or v6. Nullable for privacy and evidence preservation.

ip.description:
Last known IP address for the session (tracked for security). See `sessions.ip`.

May be IPv4 or v6. Nullable for privacy and evidence preservation.

created_at.description:
Timestamp for session creation.

Used for activity auditing, anomaly detection, and compliance chain of events.

oneOf.description:
Timestamp if session was revoked (e.g., logout, sec event, GDPR). Null if active.

See `sessions.revoked_at` in schema for audit/evidence.

revoked_at.description:
Timestamp if session was revoked (e.g., logout, sec event, GDPR). Null if active.

See `sessions.revoked_at` in schema for audit/evidence.

ISession.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new user session record, as defined in the Core schema (`sessions`).

Enforces normalization, evidence, and integrity for authentication and session tracking.

user_id.description:
References the user for whom the session is being created.

Business logic must validate this exists in the users table (`users.id`).

token.description:
Opaque unique authentication token for the session.

Generated securely and must not duplicate existing values in `sessions.token`.

expires_at.description:
Datetime for native session expiration.

Required for compliance, auto-logout, and session lifecycle logic.

oneOf.description:
Optional device fingerprint for fraud/anomaly/analytics tracking.

See `sessions.device_fingerprint`.

device_fingerprint.description:
Optional device fingerprint for fraud/anomaly/analytics tracking.

See `sessions.device_fingerprint`.

oneOf.description:
Optional client IP address (IPv4/v6).

May be populated for security tracking; null for privacy situations.

ip.description:
Optional client IP address (IPv4/v6).

May be populated for security tracking; null for privacy situations.

ISession.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a session entity. Only mutable fields (expires_at, device_fingerprint, ip, revoked_at) are accepted.

Use for compliance, session lifecycle actions, or evidence enrichment. See Core schema `sessions`.

oneOf.description: Update expiry of session. Set to null for indefinite extension (regulated by business logic).

expires_at.description: Update expiry of session. Set to null for indefinite extension (regulated by business logic).

oneOf.description: Update to device fingerprint (if device context changes or new data is available).

device_fingerprint.description: Update to device fingerprint (if device context changes or new data is available).

oneOf.description: Update client's IP address for traceability/audit.

ip.description: Update client's IP address for traceability/audit.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when session is revoked/logged-out or forcibly ended for evidence.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp when session is revoked/logged-out or forcibly ended for evidence.

ICoreSession.IDeleteResult.description:
Result of a user session deletion (typically soft delete). Returns operation status and any relevant audit evidence markers.

Session records are marked for audit, never hard deleted outside system regulation (see `sessions`).

success.description: Whether the session was successfully deleted (soft delete/revoke).

session_id.description: ID of the session record affected (matches `sessions.id`).

deleted_at.description: Timestamp at which the session was deleted/revoked (for audit/compliance tracking).

ICoreLocale.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for paginating, searching, and filtering locale (language/region) records.

References the `locales` table in the Core schema for I18N, a11y, and multicultural management workflows.

oneOf.description: General search filter, applied to code or name fields for fuzzy searching. Optional.

search.description: General search filter, applied to code or name fields for fuzzy searching. Optional.

oneOf.description:
Optional, advanced object for structured filtering by locale attributes.

May include fields such as code, name, etc.

filter.description:
Optional, advanced object for structured filtering by locale attributes.

May include fields such as code, name, etc.

oneOf.description: Sorting of results (field name, direction, e.g., 'name:asc').

sort.description: Sorting of results (field name, direction, e.g., 'name:asc').

oneOf.description: Page number for pagination (1-based indexing).
Limit of records per page. Default is system-configured (often 100).

limit.description: Limit of records per page. Default is system-configured (often 100).

IPageICoreLocale.description:
Paginated response container for a set of locale records.

Implements the shared IPage<T> convention, with CoreLocale records as items and paging metadata per system standards. Used for admin and client I18N lists.

data.description: Current page records: array of individual locale objects.

ICoreLocale.description:
Describes a single locale/language-region entry in the Core `locales` table.

Provides BCP 47 compliance for regional multi-language support, see requirements for accessible and multicultural flows.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the locale record. `locales.id`.

Evidence-grade, never reused or recycled.

code.description:
BCP 47 code for the locale (`locales.code`).

Used throughout the system to context-switch localizations/UI. E.g., 'en-US', 'ko-KR'.

name.description:
Human-readable local name (`locales.name`).

Used in UIs, preference selectors, and reporting.

ICoreLocale.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new locale/language-region entry.

Must conform to BCP 47 for code and supply a name string. Used by admin/localization flows only.

code.description: BCP 47 code for the new locale. Unique in the system (see `locales.code`).

name.description: Human-friendly name for the locale (e.g., 'English (United States)').

ICoreLocale.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating locale details. Allows change of code or name only for non-deprecated locales.

Admin action only, with evidence trace required for compliance.

oneOf.description: Update to BCP 47 locale code (optional, must remain unique).

code.description: Update to BCP 47 locale code (optional, must remain unique).

oneOf.description: New human-readable name for locale (optional; required for major renames).

name.description: New human-readable name for locale (optional; required for major renames).

ICoreLocale.IDeleteResult.description:
Result of a locale record deletion. Used for evidence, audit, and compliance workflows when removing a supported locale from the platform.

No removal of records is allowed if the locale is in use or under hold. See `locales`.

success.description: Indicates whether the deletion was completed (soft delete, set inactive, etc).

locale_id.description: The unique identifier for the deleted locale.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for logical removal or archival, for compliance audit.

Request object for paginated, filtered list/search of user consent records in Core.consents.

Used for DSAR, regulatory, analytics dashboards. Includes common pagination, searching, and consent status filters.

oneOf.description: General search (applies to type or user email, etc.).

search.description: General search (applies to type or user email, etc.).

oneOf.description: Structured filter object. Possible fields: user_id, type, granted state, etc.

filter.description: Structured filter object. Possible fields: user_id, type, granted state, etc.

limit.description: Maximum records per page (regulatory default: 100).

IPageICoreConsent.description:
Paginated result set container for Core.consents (user consent records).

Implements the IPage<T> pattern for standardized regulatory, privacy, and analytics systems. Each entry is a consent record, with paging metadata and full evidence context.

data.description: List of matching user consent entries.

id.description:
Primary Key. Unique consent record (Prisma: consents.id). Links to a specific consent instance for a user.

The UUID ensures non-collision and referential integrity across distributed systems and audit logs. Required for compliance tracking and regulatory DSAR responses.

user_id.description:
User ID. Foreign key to users.id (Prisma: consents.user_id). Indicates the user to whom this consent record applies.

Required for evidencing consent provenance (GDPR/CCPA, etc.).

type.description:
Type of consent (e.g., 'ai_training', 'marketing', 'data_sharing'). Uniquely identifies the nature of each permission per user (Prisma: consents.type).

Business rules validate the uniqueness of (user_id, type) to ensure traceability at a granular level for compliance exports.

is_granted.description:
Is Granted. Indicates if consent has been given or revoked (Prisma: consents.is_granted).

A boolean for fast analysis by privacy dashboards or compliance modules.

granted_at.description:
Timestamp when consent was granted (Prisma: consents.granted_at).

Crucial for regulatory evidence and time-bounded permission tracking. Immutable after creation.

oneOf.description:
Timestamp when consent was revoked or made inactive (nullable; Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

Used for evidencing lifecycle of consent, compliance reporting, and time-window analysis.

revoked_at.description:
Timestamp when consent was revoked or made inactive (nullable; Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

Used for evidencing lifecycle of consent, compliance reporting, and time-window analysis.

ICoreConsent.description:
Consent Entity. Fulfills regulatory consent management and audit tracking for user data access, AI/ML operations, and communications (see Prisma model consents).

Captures each explicit user consent by type, records all relevant timestamps, and preserves an immutable audit paper trail.

References: GDPR/CCPA compliance, user privacy dashboard requirements.

user_id.description: Target user to whom the consent applies (Prisma: consents.user_id).

type.description: Consent type/category, such as 'ai_training', 'marketing', or 'analytics' (Prisma: consents.type).

is_granted.description: Indicates opt-in/out status. Defaults to true if granted, false if declined (Prisma: consents.is_granted).

granted_at.description: Timestamp when the consent was granted or created (Prisma: consents.granted_at).

oneOf.description:
Optional: When consent is revoked (Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

Should be null if not revoked at creation.

revoked_at.description:
Optional: When consent is revoked (Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

Should be null if not revoked at creation.

ICoreConsent.ICreate.description:
Consent Creation DTO. Used for creating a new user consent entry, as per regulatory evidence requirements.

All fields are needed to ensure reliable audit and privacy compliance.

is_granted.description: Update granted/active status per business/user action (Prisma: consents.is_granted).

granted_at.description: Update for timestamp when consent is (re-)granted (Prisma: consents.granted_at).

oneOf.description: If revoked, timestamp when the consent is revoked (Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

revoked_at.description: If revoked, timestamp when the consent is revoked (Prisma: consents.revoked_at).

ICoreConsent.IUpdate.description:
Consent Update DTO. Used to update an existing user consent record’s active status, type, or timestamps for regulatory lifecycle management.

Any field may be provided; updates are always evidence-logged.

id.description:
ID of the consent deleted/archived (Prisma: consents.id).

Used for confirmation and evidence audit.

deleted.description: Indicates if the consent has been soft-deleted (archived) according to compliance and traceability policies.

ICoreConsent.IDeleteResult.description: Consent Soft Delete Result. Used in response and audit trails to confirm compliance-preserving removal (soft delete) actions.

user_id.description:
Optional: Filter logs to target user_id (Prisma: access_logs.user_id).

Used in user self-audits or admin security reports.

session_id.description: Optional: Filter for a specific session context (Prisma: access_logs.session_id).

event_type.description:
Optional: Filter events by type (e.g. 'login', 'api_call'; Prisma: access_logs.event_type).

Critical for event-frequency analytics and regulatory queries.

ip.description:
Optional: Filter by originating IP address (Prisma: access_logs.ip).

Allows for investigation of suspicious or targeted activities.

agent.description:
Optional: Filter by user agent string (Prisma: access_logs.agent).

Useful in device/user analytics and forensics.

success.description: Optional: Filter by authentication or action result success/failure (Prisma: access_logs.success).

occurred_at_from.description:
Optional: Lower bound filter on occurred_at (Prisma: access_logs.occurred_at).

Supports range queries for compliance export and anomaly detection.

occurred_at_to.description:
Optional: Upper bound filter on occurred_at.

Critical for point-in-time analysis, breach tracing, and incident investigation.

page.description: Page number for paginated retrieval. Default 1.

limit.description: Max results per page, for rate limiting/large exports.

ICoreAccessLog.IRequest.description:
Access Log Query/Search DTO. Enables advanced, filterable retrieval of access log records for user, security, and regulatory evidencing.

Directly references normalized access_logs table fields (Prisma schema).

data.description: List of paginated access logs for the current page/query.

IPageICoreAccessLog.description:
Paginated Access Log DTO. Return type for access log search APIs, compliant with evidence and security monitoring requirements.

Wraps results and supports metadata for client-side pagination and audit export workflows.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique access log record (Prisma: access_logs.id).

user_id.description: Foreign key to users.id for this access event (Prisma: access_logs.user_id).

oneOf.description: Foreign key to the session in which the event occurred (Prisma: access_logs.session_id). Nullable for system/service access.

session_id.description: Foreign key to the session in which the event occurred (Prisma: access_logs.session_id). Nullable for system/service access.

event_type.description: Type of access event: e.g., 'login', 'logout', 'api_call' (Prisma: access_logs.event_type).

agent.description: User agent or device string (Prisma: access_logs.agent).

success.description: Outcome of the action: true for successful, false for failure (Prisma: access_logs.success).

occurred_at.description:
Timestamp of when the access event occurred (Prisma: access_logs.occurred_at).

Immutable after log entry creation; used for audit trace chains.

ICoreAccessLog.description:
Access Log Entity. Immutable, evidence-grade record of authentication or access events as per access_logs table (Prisma schema).

Supports regulatory, security, forensics, and DSAR activities.

user_id.description: FK to user performing/accessed (Prisma: access_logs.user_id).

oneOf.description: FK to session context. Nullable if not session-driven.

session_id.description: FK to session context. Nullable if not session-driven.

event_type.description: Type of access event, e.g., 'login', 'api_call', etc. (Prisma: access_logs.event_type).

ip.description: Origin IP address of access (Prisma: access_logs.ip).

success.description: Whether the access was successful (Prisma: access_logs.success).

ICoreAccessLog.ICreate.description: Access Log Creation DTO. Used for recording system or user access events for regulatory, analytics, and forensics audit.

event_type.description:
Mutable: Correct event type if initially set wrong.

Immutability may be enforced by policy in production.

ip.description: Mutable: Correction of source IP if incorrect or anonymized for privacy.

agent.description: Mutable: Correction or extension with device info for audit/context.

success.description: Mutable: Administrative correction of true/false as allowed by compliance.

ICoreAccessLog.IUpdate.description: Access Log Update DTO. Used for administrative/amendment of access logs, with all mutations immutably logged for audit and evidence.

id.description: ID of the access log entry marked as deleted (Prisma: access_logs.id).

deleted.description: Indicates if the record was successfully deleted (soft-deleted/archived per compliance).

ICoreAccessLog.IDeleteResult.description: Access Log Delete Result DTO. Used for audit/compliance confirmation of logical removal.

name.description: Optional: Filter by product name (Prisma: products.name). Fuzzy or exact match as per business UI/query context.

internal_code.description: Optional: Filter by internal code/identifier (Prisma: products.internal_code). Often used for supply chain or internal reference search.

status.description: Optional: Filter product records by status (e.g., 'active', 'draft', 'archived').

created_at_from.description: Optional: Lower bound filter (from) for product creation timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Optional: Upper bound filter (to) for product creation timestamp.

category.description: Optional: Filter products by associated category (schema-driven expansion based on product_categories).

limit.description: Maximum results per page as per API default/rate limits.

IProductCatalogProduct.IRequest.description:
Product Search/List DTO. Accepts advanced query and filter params for retrieving matching products, as per products table fields (Prisma schema).

All search fields are fully normalized and mapped to evidence-driven audit workflows.

data.description: Product records for the current page/query, as matching product list/search criteria.

IPageIProductCatalogProduct.description:
Paginated Product List DTO. Returns a page of products, supporting catalog search, analytics, and audit compliance.

Metadata supports navigation for UIs and downstream analysis tools. Structured for full audit and regulatory trace.

IProductCatalogProduct.description: Detailed ProductCatalog product object as per products table definition in Prisma DB schema. Used as context for catalog, event, audit, and evidence embedding.

IProductCatalogProduct.ICreate.description:
신규 제품 생성에 필요한 페이로드 타입입니다. 카탈로그 정규화 규칙에 따라 name, description, internal_code, status 등 필수 입력값과 생성/수정 이력용 유저 ID를 포함합니다.

신규 제품 등록 시, business logic 에서는 중복 internal_code, 필수 필드 누락, 조직/권한 유효성, AI 트리거링 등을 검증합니다.

created_by_user_id.description: 제품 최초 등록자(사용자 ID). 필수. 감사 및 책임 추적, 내부 규정 준수 목적.

updated_by_user_id.description: 초기 생성자와 동일하게 입력. 최초 생성시에는 생성자와 동일, 이후 수정 요청에는 변경됨.

name.description: 제품 공식명. UI 표기 및 검색 키. 예: 'Apple iPhone 23'.

description.description: 제품 설명문. 마케팅, AI 태깅/분석에 활용.

internal_code.description: 조직 내 유일한 내부 코드. 외부 연동 및 벤더 시스템과의 싱크에 필요.

status.description: 초기 등록 시점의 상태. 예: 'draft', 'active'. 결재/승인 로직과 워크플로우 분리 목적.

IProductCatalogProduct.IUpdate.description:
제품 정보 업데이트(수정)에 필요한 페이로드 타입. 수정 가능 필드만 포함.

모든 수정 작업은 업데이트 사용자의 user_id, 변경 대상 제품 식별자, 변경 필드에 대한 유효성 체크, 중복 internal_code 방지, 기업 정책 및 AI 피드백 처리까지 반영.

updated_by_user_id.description: 변경을 시도하는 사용자 ID. 업데이트 이력 감사, 관리 책임 추적.

name.description: 수정 대상 제품의 공식명. (선택적)

description.description: 수정 대상 제품의 상세 설명 (옵션, 일부만 수정 가능).

internal_code.description: 수정 시에도 유일성 검증이 필요한 내부 코드.

status.description: 제품의 상태 필드 변경.

IProductCatalogProduct.IDeleteResult.description:
제품 삭제(소프트 삭제 포함) 결과를 반환하는 표준 응답 모델입니다.

삭제는 실제 DB 삭제가 아니라 deleted_at 타임스탬프 기록 또는 상태 필드 변경(archived 등)로 이뤄지며, 감사 추적 및 복구, 규정 컴플라이언스를 보장합니다.

id.description: 삭제(아카이브) 적용된 제품의 고유 식별자

status.description: 삭제(archived/retired) 후 제품의 상태값. 운영 뷰(ex: 'archived')

deleted_at.description: 소프트 삭제 또는 아카이브 적용 시 타임스탬프. 감사/증적/복구 근거로 활용

IProductCatalogProductVariant.IRequest.description:
제품 변형(Variant) 목록 요청을 위한 페이로드 타입입니다.

필터: product_id, SKU/바코드 검색, 상태(활성화, 아카이브), 생성/수정 일시, 임포트 피드, 페이징(offset/limit) - AI 기반 재고 분석, 카탈로그 운영, 관리자 검수 등 다양한 시나리오에 활용.

요청 예시 필드: product_id, sku, barcode, available, import_feed_id, created_at(범위), updated_at(범위), offset, limit, 정렬옵션 etc.

product_id.description: 기준이 되는 제품(Parent product)의 UUID. 필터링 옵션.

available.description: 사용 가능 여부에 따른 필터링 (판매 가능/불가 등).

import_feed_id.description: 외부 데이터 연동 - 임포트 피드(UUID) 기준 검색.

limit.description: 페이지당 반환할 개수. (기본값 100)

IPageIProductCatalogProductVariant.description:
제품 변형 목록 페이징 컨테이너. IPage<T> 표준 구조로 반환되며, 데이터 배열/페이징 정보 필드 제공. 각 데이터 항목은 IProductCatalogProductVariant 타입 참조.

페이징 및 대용량 리스트 UX/DB 효율 최적화 목적.

data.description: 페이지 내 반환된 제품 변형 리스트

id.description: Unique primary key for the variant. See product_variants.id in Prisma schema.

product_id.description: Reference to the parent product.

import_feed_id.description: Reference to source import feed if this variant was loaded from external data.

sku.description: Stock-keeping unit (SKU / unique variant code). Used in commerce, fulfillment, analytics.

price.description: Current unit price for this variant.

available.description: Whether the variant is available for sale.

created_at.description: Timestamp of variant creation.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this variant was last updated.

IProductCatalogProductVariant.description: Detailed product variant entity as defined in Prisma ProductCatalog.product_variants table. Used throughout inventory, cart/order, and catalog evidencing.

IProductCatalogProductVariant.ICreate.description:
제품 변형(Variant) 신규 생성 요청 타입. 필수: 소속 제품, SKU, 가격, 바코드, 활성화 여부. 임포트 피드 연관시 import_feed_id 필요.

비즈니스 규칙: SKU/바코드 유일, 가격 무결, 참조 무결성, AI/재고/주문 시스템 연계 이슈 처리 필수. 생성 이후 immutable evidence(감사/AI 피드백)로 활용.

product_id.description: Varaiant가 소속된 제품의 UUID. 필수.

import_feed_id.description: 외부 임포트 피드로 생성시 연결. 직접 등록이면 null.

price.description: 단일 가격(최신값). AI 기반 동적 가격/추천 연동시 실시간 활용.

barcode.description: 해당 변형의 바코드. 전체 시스템에서 유일해야 함.

IProductVariant.IUpdate.description:
제품 변형 업데이트를 위한 페이로드 타입.

변형별 개별 필드만 수정 가능하며, 가격 업데이트·재고 동기화·임포트 피드 변경·활성화 상태 변경 등의 다양한 시나리오에서 사용. 업데이트시 데이터 정합성, 프라이버시, 감사/Audit 트레일 요구사항을 모두 만족해야 함.

IProductVariant.description:
제품 변형의 전체 상태 반환(읽기전용). IProductCatalogProductVariant와 유사하지만, 추가 데이터(재고 등) 포함될 수 있음.

대량 리스트/관리 API에서 활용 가능. 모든 변경 이력 및 증적 필드 반영 가능.

id.description: 변형 고유 식별자

product_id.description: 소속 제품(UUID)

created_at.description: 생성일

IProductVariant.IDeleteResult.description:
제품 변형 삭제(soft/hard both, evidence chain 보존) 결과 리턴 객체.

삭제된 변형의 식별 값, 삭제 상태, 삭제(아카이브) 처리 시각 등 필드로 구성. Traceability, compliance, evidence export시 활용.

id.description: 삭제된 변형 고유 식별자

status.description: 삭제(아카이브) 후 현재 상태(

deleted_at.description: 삭제(아카이브) 적용 시 타임스탬프

IProductCategory.IRequest.description:
카테고리(분류체계) 목록/검색용 요청 타입. 계층구조(parent_id), 이름 검색, 생성/수정일 필터, 페이징, 다국어 UI/관리시스템 연동 등 다양한 플로우를 지원합니다.

필드: parent_id(계층 필터), name(부분검색), created_at/updated_at 범위, page/offset/limit/sort.

parent_id.description: 상위(부모) 카테고리 UUID. 계층 트리/분류별 하위 조회에 활용.

name.description: 이름 부분검색(예: GIN 인덱스 기반 fast 검색, a11y/다국어 연결됨).

limit.description: 페이지당 반환할 결과 개수(기본값 100)

pagination.description: Pagination information for the product category list. This references the standard IPage.IPagination object, which contains metadata about current page, limit, record count, and total pages, as described in the generic pagination module.

data.description: A list of product category records. Each item is a full IProductCategory entity as specified below.

IPageIProductCategory.description:
A paginated list container for product categories.

This type is used as the response wrapper for all list/search operations on product categories in the product_catalog management module (see requirements and Prisma schema comments for thorough documentation). It includes full product category DTOs and paging metadata, ensuring scalable responses for UI or analytics modules.

The structure is based on the standard IPage<T> interface, with category-specific typing for the primary data array.

id.description: Globally unique product category identifier. References 'id' in product_categories (PK).

oneOf.description: Optional parent category reference. Null for root categories. Based on 3NF normalization requirements and supporting unlimited hierarchical taxonomies (see ER diagrams, requirements, and schema comment).

parent_id.description: Optional parent category reference. Null for root categories. Based on 3NF normalization requirements and supporting unlimited hierarchical taxonomies (see ER diagrams, requirements, and schema comment).

name.description: Human-readable category name. Must be unique and atomic. E.g., 'Apparel', 'Shoes', 'Men's Running'. Enforced by the unique constraint in the Prisma DB schema.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was created. Essential for audit/evidence, analytics, and materialized views. Required by audit/compliance log modules.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the category. Enables change tracking, compliance, and analytics. Not derived from other fields.

IProductCategory.description:
Represents a single product category in the catalog, aligned with the Product Management module requirements and Prisma DB schema.

This entity forms the basis of faceted, hierarchical product taxonomy, as required for discoverability, navigation, and AI-driven enrichment (see requirements for AI/ML enrichment, analytics, evidence preservation, and global commerce adaptation).

The design ensures strict 3NF—parent/child relationships are normalized via parent_id. All metadata is captured for compliance, evidence, and audit tracking.

oneOf.description: Optional parent category's unique identifier. Enables creating hierarchical category trees. Null for root.

parent_id.description: Optional parent category's unique identifier. Enables creating hierarchical category trees. Null for root.

name.description: Name of the new product category. Must be unique and atomic as per schema constraint. For example, 'Outdoor Shoes'.

IProductCategory.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new product category.

Maps to fields in product_categories. Parent_id enables tree/hierarchy. Name uniqueness is validated per requirements and schema constraints. Used by product/category managers and extensible to support automated AI/ML onboarding.

oneOf.description: Optionally update the parent category; must be null or valid root. Hierarchy integrity validated on update.

parent_id.description: Optionally update the parent category; must be null or valid root. Hierarchy integrity validated on update.

name.description: Update the category's human-readable name. Must remain unique.

IProductCategory.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a product category by id.

All fields are optional, but any present are validated for 3NF, uniqueness, and business logic. Used by catalog admins and in onboarding/management UI.

id.description: Deleted product category's unique identifier.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted/archived for compliance/evidence preservation.

evidence.description: Optional field containing audit log reference/evidence hash, supporting regulatory trace and non-repudiation (fulfilled by audit/chain-of-custody modules).

IProductCategory.IDeleteResult.description:
Status/result payload for a product category's soft-deletion.

Preserves evidence of deletion in accordance with audit and compliance requirements from the product_catalog and compliance modules. Presents confirmation to admins and is referenced in downstream evidence exports.

oneOf.description: Optional filter: product to which option is scoped. Allows listing only options for that product.

product_id.description: Optional filter: product to which option is scoped. Allows listing only options for that product.

oneOf.description: Filter: type/kind of the product option (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Enables faceted onboarding, bulk operations.

option_type.description: Filter: type/kind of the product option (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Enables faceted onboarding, bulk operations.

oneOf.description: Filter: exact or partial search for product option value (e.g., 'Red'). Used for query and auto-suggest in onboarding flows.

value.description: Filter: exact or partial search for product option value (e.g., 'Red'). Used for query and auto-suggest in onboarding flows.

oneOf.description: Which page of data to return (pagination). See IPage.IRequest for details.

page.description: Which page of data to return (pagination). See IPage.IRequest for details.

oneOf.description: Maximum number of records per page. Default depends on system policy.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page. Default depends on system policy.

IProductOption.IRequest.description:
Payload structure for paginated, filtered search of product options.

Supports onboarding, analytics, bulk edits, and catalog QA workflows. Mirrors best practices for API search semantics and is consistent with related IPageIProductOption patterns.

pagination.description: Pagination details as per IPage structure.

data.description: Result set containing all product options for this page/query.

IPageIProductOption.description:
Paginated list wrapper for product option search.

Fulfills evidence-grade and analytics readiness requirements as per the product_catalog management and data science needs, referencing all query context in pagination.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product option. PK in 'product_options'.

product_id.description: Identifies the product this option belongs to. FK in product_options.

option_type.description: Type/kind of the product option (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Enables AI onboarding and multi-variant support.

value.description: Atomic option value (e.g., 'Red', 'XL'). Fully normalized and used for search, analytics, onboarding.

IProductOption.description:
Represents a single product option for a product in the product catalog.

Implements the graded attribute/variant structure per requirements and DB schema comments. Forms the basis for onboarding, analytics, and variant management. AI workflows may auto-suggest or import these during catalog enrichment.

product_id.description: The product to which this option will be added. Must reference a valid product.

option_type.description: The type of option to associate with the product (e.g., 'color', 'size').

value.description: Atomic string value—must be unique per product:type:value tuple (see DB schema uniqueness/analytics requirements).

IProductOption.ICreate.description:
Creation payload for a new product option/attribute for onboarding, AI-driven catalog management, or manual entry.

Input is validated for reference integrity, uniqueness, and normalization per catalog management requirements.

option_type.description: Option type to update (e.g., to fix onboarding/mapping errors or attribute promotion). Validation enforces normalization.

value.description: Atomic option value to update; must comply with evidence trace and 3NF policy.

IProductOption.IUpdate.description:
Update structure for a product option in the catalog.

Only permitted fields (option_type, value) are mutable. Used in onboarding error correction, analytics feedback, or catalog QA.

id.description: Deleted product option's unique identifier.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when option was removed (evidence chain preservation, not physical deletion).

evidence.description: Audit log/event reference (evidence hash, chain-of-custody id).

IProductOption.IDeleteResult.description:
Delete result for product option—evidence-preserving per compliance.

Used for downstream analytics, regulatory reporting, and compliance investigation workflows.

oneOf.description: Optional filter/search: tag value. Supports partial/fuzzy search for tag auto-suggest, AI onboarding, or analytics exploration.

value.description: Optional filter/search: tag value. Supports partial/fuzzy search for tag auto-suggest, AI onboarding, or analytics exploration.

oneOf.description: Pagination page; refers to IPage.IRequest for structure.

page.description: Pagination page; refers to IPage.IRequest for structure.

oneOf.description: Page size/limit, with system default.

limit.description: Page size/limit, with system default.

IProductTag.IRequest.description:
Filter, pagination, and search structure for listing product tags in catalog management or data science flows.

Enables tag onboarding, analytics, and AI suggestion integration. Used throughout evidence, audit, and catalog hygiene modules.

pagination.description:
페이지네이션 정보입니다.

IPage.IPagination 스키마와 동일하며, 전체 태그 결과 세트의 페이징 정보를 제공합니다.

data.description:
조회 결과에 포함된 단일 ProductTag 객체의 배열입니다.

각 배열 요소는 IProductTag 타입으로, 제품 태그 데이터에 대한 모든 속성을 포함합니다.

IPageIProductTag.description:
제품 태그의 페이징이 적용된 결과 목록을 나타냅니다.

각 ProductTag는 제품 카탈로그 내의 확장 가능한 태그 엔터티를 나타내며, AI 기반의 AI/ML 추천, 트렌드 분석, 필터링 및 다국어 검색 기능 구현에 사용됩니다.

태그 페이징 결과는 검색, 필터, 전체 카운트, 데이터 객체 목록을 포함합니다.

id.description:
고유 ID입니다. 모든 태그 레코드에 대해 전역적으로 유일하며, PK 역할을 합니다.

Prisma product_tags.id 컬럼 주석을 참고하세요.

value.description:
태그의 실체 값(예: '트렌디', '겨울세일', 'AI-generated: trending' 등).

카탈로그 내 고속 검색, 필터, 태그 기반 AI 추천·분류 기능에 사용합니다. Prisma product_tags.value 컬럼 참고.

유일성 보장.

created_at.description:
태그가 생성된 시간입니다. 감사, 증적 보전, ML 파이프라인 데이터 기반 생성에 활용됩니다.

Prisma product_tags.created_at 컬럼 참고.

IProductTag.description:
ProductTag 엔터티는 카탈로그 내의 논리적 태그 단위를 나타냅니다.

AI/ML 추천, 검색 엔진 강화, 트렌드 인식 등에서 활용되며, 각 태그는 독립적 객체입니다.

id와 value는 유일성을 가지며, 생성 시점(created_at) 정보 등 모든 이력이 감사 및 증적 레벨로 보존됩니다.

설계 철학상 태그 레코드는 임의 삭제를 금지하고, 하위 객체(ex: products 등)에 대한 대응관계를 다대다로 관리합니다.

value.description:
등록하고자 하는 태그 값입니다. 예: '친환경', '2025여름'.

검색/추천/필터링 엔진 및 분석용으로 사용될 수 있으며, value는 유일성 보장 대상입니다.

Prisma product_tags.value 컬럼 참고.

IProductTag.ICreate.description:
신규 제품 태그를 생성하기 위한 입력 타입입니다.

고속 제품 탐색, 추천/AI 기반 태그 생성, 태그 기반 제품 검색 등 다양한 AI-native 기능 지원에 활용됩니다.

value는 유일해야 하며, 모든 입력 값은 데이터 무결성과 증적성을 보장하여 영구 추적 및 감사 가능하도록 설계되어야 합니다.

value.description:
수정할 태그 값. 유일성(전체 시스템 내) 보장 필요.

Prisma product_tags.value 컬럼 참고.

IProductTag.IUpdate.description:
기존 제품 태그의 속성(주로 value)을 수정하는 데 사용되는 타입입니다.

실제 태그의 값 변경은 비즈니스 정책상 제한될 수 있으며, 변경 이력은 증적/감사 로그에 반드시 영구 추적되어야 합니다.

id.description: 삭제된 대상 엔터티의 고유 식별자(UUID)입니다.

oneOf.description: 삭제 또는 아카이빙 처리 결과 상태. deleted: 논리적 삭제, archived: 증적 보전을 위한 영구 보관.
삭제 또는 아카이빙 처리 결과 상태. deleted: 논리적 삭제, archived: 증적 보전을 위한 영구 보관.

status.description: 삭제 또는 아카이빙 처리 결과 상태. deleted: 논리적 삭제, archived: 증적 보전을 위한 영구 보관.

deletedAt.description: 실제 삭제 처리(soft-delete/아카이빙) 일시로, 운영·규제 준수·증적 보장을 위해 필수 기록됩니다.

IDeleteResponse.description:
엔터티 삭제, 아카이빙 등 제거성 작업의 최종 결과를 표준화해 반환하는 일반 응답 구조입니다.

모든 삭제(soft/hard) 작업은 증적 보존 및 규제 준수 원칙에 따라 일시, 상태, 식별자가 반드시 기록됩니다.

media_type.description:
필터링을 위한 미디어 타입(예: 'image', 'video' 등).

Prisma product_media.media_type 컬럼 참고.

locale.description:
미디어 컨텐츠의 다국어 지원을 위한 locale 값(예: 'ko-KR', 'en-US').

Prisma product_media.locale 컬럼 참고.

alt_text.description:
접근성(a11y) 및 검색, 자동 분류용 Alt Text 필터. 부분 일치 검색 등 지원 권장.

Prisma product_media.alt_text 컬럼 참고.

product_id.description: 해당 미디어가 연결된 제품의 UUID. 제품 단위별 미디어 조회 등 필터링에 사용.

product_variant_id.description: 옵션별(Variant) 미디어 필터링에 사용되는 ID. product_variant와 단일 연결.

created_from.description: 미디어 생성일자 시작 범위 필터링(이후 일자부터 검색).

created_to.description: 미디어 생성일자 종료 범위 필터링(이전 일자까지 검색).

offset.description: 결과 출력 시 시작 인덱스. 페이지네이션 음수 불가.

limit.description: 페이지당 최대 출력 개수(기본 100 등).

IProductMedia.IRequest.description:
제품 미디어 검색 또는 조회 요청에 사용되는 파라미터 객체입니다.

AI/ML 기반 이미지 분석, 접근성(a11y) 감사, 콘텐츠 분류, 대용량 검색엔진 파이프라인 등에서 폭넓게 활용됩니다.

pagination.description:
페이지네이션 정보 객체.

전체 미디어 목록 또는 필터 결과에 대한 페이징 메타 정보입니다.

data.description:
단일 ProductMedia 객체의 목록(배열).

각 ProductMedia 객체에는 모든 미디어 메타데이터 및 증적, 접근성 메타, 분류 정보 등이 포함됩니다.

IPageIProductMedia.description:
제품 미디어(이미지, 영상 등) 객체에 대한 페이징 결과를 담는 컨테이너 형식입니다.

다국어, a11y, AI 자동 인식 태그, URI, 생성일시 등 전속성 포함.

id.description:
제품 미디어 고유 식별자(UUID). PK 역할입니다.

Prisma product_media.id 컬럼.

product_id.description:
연결된 제품의 UUID. Null 가능.

Prisma product_media.product_id 컬럼.

product_variant_id.description:
연결된 옵션(Variant) UUID. Null 가능. 제품 또는 옵션 중 하나만 연결.

Prisma product_media.product_variant_id 컬럼.

uri.description:
원본 디지털 에셋(이미지/영상/PDF 등) URI.

실제 파일은 별도 저장소에 위치.

media_type.description: 미디어 타입(예: 'image', 'video', 'pdf' 등). ML/추천엔진 문맥 추론에도 사용.

locale.description: 미디어의 다국어/다문화 구분 로케일 코드. 접근성(a11y) 및 글로벌 검색에 필수.

alt_text.description:
접근성(a11y) 준수를 위한 Alt Text. WCAG 표준 등 글로벌 규격 반영.

모든 이미지/미디어마다 반드시 제공해야 하며 AI 학습에도 활용.

created_at.description: 미디어가 생성된 시각. 인덱싱, 감사, AI 분석 등에서 사용합니다.

IProductMedia.description:
제품에 연결된 디지털 에셋(이미지, 비디오 등)의 메타데이터 개체로, ProductMedia는 엄격히 단일 파일 단위를 가집니다.

다국어, 다문화, 접근성(a11y) 표준, AI 파이프라인, 감사/증적 요구사항 모두 만족하며, 제품별/옵션별로 다수 생성될 수 있습니다.

모든 필드는 3NF 정상화를 보장하며, 파일/BLOB은 외부 저장에 URI만 DB에 저장합니다.

product_id.description: 이 미디어가 연결될 제품 UUID. product_id와 product_variant_id 중 반드시 한 개는 세팅 필요.

product_variant_id.description: 이 미디어가 연결될 옵션(Variant) UUID. null 허용.

uri.description: 업로드 후 저장소 내 디지털 에셋 URI. 실제 값은 파일 관리 시스템에서 할당.

media_type.description: 미디어 타입(예: 'image', 'video' 등). AI/ML 인식에도 활용됨.

alt_text.description: 접근성(a11y) 표준에 부합하는 Alt Text. AI 파이프라인, 콘텐츠 감사, 글로벌 서비스 필수.

IProductMedia.ICreate.description:
신규 제품 미디어(이미지/영상 등) 등록을 위한 입력 타입입니다.

접근성, 글로벌 다국어, AI 기반 분류, 증적 보전 등 필수 데이터만 입력 가능합니다. product_id, product_variant_id는 둘 중 하나 반드시 필요.

uri.description: 이미 업로드된 디지털 에셋의 URI(경로)를 수정할 때 사용(실제 변경은 예외적 상황만 허용).

media_type.description: 미디어타입 수정(타입 실수/부정확 시 통제차원에서만 변경 허용).

alt_text.description: 이미지/영상 접근성 텍스트(a11y)를 수정. 이력은 반드시 감사 로그에 남겨야 함.

IProductMedia.IUpdate.description:
기존 제품 미디어의 메타 정보(URI, 타입, 로케일, 접근성)를 수정할 때 사용하는 타입.

메타 정보 이외의 연결(product/variant)은 불변 원칙(정책상 예외는 반드시 증적 추적 필수)

product_variant_id.description: 재고 조회 대상이 되는 옵션(variant) UUID. 옵션-재고 1:1 매핑 구조.

limit.description: 페이지당 최대 결과 개수. 기본 100 등 시스템 기본 설정으로 제약.

IInventory.IRequest.description:
제품 옵션(Variant) 단위로 재고를 검색할 때 사용하는 요청 파라미터 묶음입니다.

수요/공급 예측 AI, 실시간 재고 연동, 다국어/글로벌 재고 분석 등 다양한 업무/AI 파이프라인에서 사용됩니다.

pagination.description:
전체 검색 결과의 페이징/메타 정보

IPage.IPagination 스키마 참조

data.description: 단일 Inventory(재고) 객체의 배열. 각 Inventory에는 옵션, 현재 재고량, 수정이력 정보 모두 포함됨.

IPageIInventory.description:
재고(Inventroy) 엔터티의 페이징 결과를 반환하는 표준 컨테이너입니다.

옵션/제품 재고를 대용량/분산처리, 분석, 실시간 모니터링, AI 파이프라인에서 효율적으로 다루기 위한 구조입니다.

id.description:
The unique identifier for this inventory record. References the primary key in the inventory table. Essential for traceability, reference integrity, and evidence preservation.

See Prisma schema: inventory.id

product_variant_id.description:
The ID of the product_variant this inventory entry is associated with. This ensures a strict 1:1 relationship (see @@unique constraint in schema) and enables accurate stock tracking per SKU.

See Prisma schema: inventory.product_variant_id

stock_count.description:
The present available quantity of stock for this specific product variant. Critical for all commerce, fulfillment, and analytics workflows. Always an atomic integer value; never computed in the DB layer.

See Prisma schema: inventory.stock_count

last_modified_at.description:
UTC timestamp indicating when this inventory record was last updated. Required for audit, compliance, and real-time monitoring workflows.

See Prisma schema: inventory.last_modified_at

variant.description:
Reference to the related product variant object. Provides full details of the SKU/configuration this inventory is managing.

Not stored as a column in inventory; included for API response embedding only.

IInventory.description:
Represents a single, atomic inventory record for a product variant. Fulfills the evidence/logging/integrity requirements described in the Product Catalog Management module of the requirements analysis and in the inventory Prisma schema table.

All stock management must operate on these normalized, immutable records. Each inventory state update must be evidence-traced via external logs or join to catalog_events.

This type is critical for compliance, audit, analytics, dynamic pricing, and real-time availability.

product_variant_id.description:
References the product_variant for which to create this inventory record. Must point to a valid, existing variant and follows 1:1 constraint.

See inventory.product_variant_id

stock_count.description:
Initial available stock quantity for this variant at the time of creation. Must be a positive or zero integer, never negative. Business logic should handle initial sync/evidence recording.

See inventory.stock_count

last_modified_at.description:
UTC timestamp for when this inventory record is created/set. If omitted, system will default to now. Required for consistency and evidence preservation.

See inventory.last_modified_at (set to now by default)

IInventory.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new inventory record. Maps to IInventory but omits the server-generated id and focuses on user/system-supplied fields (product_variant reference, initial quantity, timestamp).

All creations must match the 1:1 variant/inventory relationship and are logged for compliance.

stock_count.description:
The value to update the available quantity of this inventory record to. Supports both increments and decrements for restock, sale, return, etc. All API updates must ensure evidence preservation and concurrency/isolation for business accuracy.

See inventory.stock_count

last_modified_at.description:
The server or business logic determined value for when this inventory change was made. Should update to the present (now) when a stock update occurs. Ensures all inventory changes have a traceable time for evidence/audit.

See inventory.last_modified_at

IInventory.IUpdate.description:
Payload for inventory updates. Allows changing only permitted mutable fields (quantity, last_modified_at). Designed for atomic updates, not for changing core references (e.g., product_variant cannot be altered after create).

Every update must trigger evidence preservation/audit trail per compliance.

id.description: The identifier of the record that was deleted (inventory, import feed, event, etc). Ensures evidence and trace for regulatory purposes.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the delete action occurred. Serves regulatory audit/evidence purposes and supports non-repudiation of deletion actions.

IDeleteConfirmation.description:
Indicates a successful resource deletion. Provides regulatory and audit evidence of the deletion event. Must be returned from all soft/hard delete endpoints to preserve traceability.

Refer to evidence preservation and legal hold requirements in the requirements and Prisma schema comments.

source_name.description: Filter by the source_name property in import_feeds (e.g., Google Shopping, Partner API). Useful for searching or grouping imports.

imported_from.description: Optional lower bound (inclusive) for filtering import_feeds.imported_at. Effective for time-based analytics and compliance reporting.

imported_to.description: Optional upper bound (inclusive) for filtering import_feeds.imported_at. Enables analytics for import activity within a time window.

search.description: Optional general string search across source_name and source_uri, using full-text or trigram indices for fuzzy matches.

page.description: Page number for result pagination. Default is 1 if not supplied.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default and enforced limits per API policy.

oneOf.description: Sort order for returned results. Supports imported_at/date or source_name, asc/desc.
Sort order for returned results. Supports imported_at/date or source_name, asc/desc.
Sort order for returned results. Supports imported_at/date or source_name, asc/desc.
Sort order for returned results. Supports imported_at/date or source_name, asc/desc.

sort.description: Sort order for returned results. Supports imported_at/date or source_name, asc/desc.

IImportFeed.IRequest.description:
Request type for searching, filtering, and paginating import feed records. Used in PATCH /productCatalog/importFeeds. Enables advanced analytics and compliance workflows.

Refer to catalog audit, provenance, and event trace requirements.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for response—current/total, limit, item count, etc. Standard for paged API responses.

data.description:
The page of import feed records meeting the current query criteria.

See IImportFeed.

IPageIImportFeed.description: Container for paginated import feed results. Follows IPage<T> pattern as defined in design standards. Supports large scale, evidence-ready API responses.

id.description: Primary key/unique identifier for the import_feed record.

source_name.description: Human-friendly label for this import source/feed. Example: 'Google Shopping', 'Partner ERP Feed'. Uniqueness enforced in DB.

id.description:
주 키이자 할인 엔티티의 고유 식별자입니다. 

시스템 내에서 모든 할인 이벤트가 식별될 수 있도록 UUID 포맷을 사용합니다.

discount_rule_id.description:
적용된 할인 룰의 @ref discount_rules.id 참조입니다.

해당 할인 정책(고정/퍼센트/AI동적 등)과 명확히 연결되어 트레이싱 가능한 구조를 제공하며, 내부/외부 컴플라이언스·이벤트 추적의 출발점입니다.

order_id.description:
연결된 주문의 @ref order.id 참조입니다.

상품 결제와 할인 적용 이력의 정확한 매핑을 보장하며, 주문 히스토리·회계 내역 감사 시에도 활용됩니다.

amount.description:
실제 적용된 할인 금액입니다.

항상 음수(할인) 또는 0이며, 화폐 단위는 order와 맞물려 각 주문/결제 단위 기준으로 동작합니다. (ex, -10000/KRW, -5.75/USD 등)

applied_at.description:
해당 할인 적용 시점을 명확하게 타임스탬프로 기록합니다.

모든 할인 이벤트의 감사 트레이닝, 컴플라이언스 보고서, 혹은 분쟁 조사에 사용되는 중요 증거 필드입니다.

oneOf.description:
할인에 대한 부연 설명, 정책 명/캠페인 매핑, 비즈니스 트랜잭션용 자유 필드입니다.

예시: 'AI 모델 기반 프로모션', '블랙프라이데이 쿠폰' 등. 변경 이력이 남는 감사/분석용 칼럼입니다.

notes.description:
할인에 대한 부연 설명, 정책 명/캠페인 매핑, 비즈니스 트랜잭션용 자유 필드입니다.

예시: 'AI 모델 기반 프로모션', '블랙프라이데이 쿠폰' 등. 변경 이력이 남는 감사/분석용 칼럼입니다.

IDiscount.description:
`discounts` 테이블을 기반으로 한 할인 개별 레코드 엔티티입니다.

- 각 필드는 Prisma DB 컬럼 주석과 정확히 일치하며, 원천 이벤트의 증거 저장/감사 보고/이상탐지에 활용됩니다.
- 할인 정책, 라인별 주문, 실제 할인 단가와 상세 이벤틋/노트까지 포함하며, 엔드투엔드 추적성을 염두에 둔 설계입니다.
- 모든 Row별 식별자는 UUID(무작위 고유)입니다.

discount_rule_id.description:
적용할 할인 룰의 식별자입니다(@ref discount_rules.id).

시스템 정책/캠페인, 또는 AI 기반 할인 적용 시 해당 룰 식별자와 1:1 연결해야 정상 동작합니다.

order_id.description:
적용 대상 주문의 UUID, @ref order.id 참조.

특정 주문 내에서만 할인이 올바로 적용되도록 보장합니다.

amount.description:
할인 금액 (항상 음수 또는 0). 

적용 대상 통화 및 포맷은 백엔드 비즈니스 로직에서 cross-check 후 입력 필수입니다.

oneOf.description:
정책명, 증빙 등 임의 부연 설명 필드입니다.

프론트에서 사용자가 직접 남기거나, 배치/AI/타 시스템에서 주입할 수 있습니다.

notes.description:
정책명, 증빙 등 임의 부연 설명 필드입니다.

프론트에서 사용자가 직접 남기거나, 배치/AI/타 시스템에서 주입할 수 있습니다.

IDiscount.ICreate.description:
새 할인 레코드(할인 적용 시 이벤트)를 생성할 때 사용하는 입력(request body) 타입입니다.

- 각 필드는 Prisma DB의 실제 컬럼 정의와 일치하고,
- amount는 DB 및 결제 시스템 정책(통화, 최소 단위 등)과 일관되어야 합니다.
- notes는 선택/증거 목적으로 소프트하게 사용 가능합니다.

컴플라이언스 및 보안, AI할인 추적 등 모든 할인 레코드 생성에 활용합니다.

amount.description:
할인 금액(음수 또는 0) – 예외 상황(수동정정, AI후보정, 감사 등)에서만 사용.

정상 주문/결제 플로우에서는 최초 생성값만 사용하지만, 취합·환불·분쟁 등에서 예외적으로 정정 가능합니다.

oneOf.description:
할인 건에 대한 부연설명/수정사유 등 입력 필드.

내부 감사, 배치 보정, 관리자 액션 등에서 변경 가능. 변경 이력이 남으며, 원본 및 보정 사유는 모든 작업에 반드시 남아야 합니다.

notes.description:
할인 건에 대한 부연설명/수정사유 등 입력 필드.

내부 감사, 배치 보정, 관리자 액션 등에서 변경 가능. 변경 이력이 남으며, 원본 및 보정 사유는 모든 작업에 반드시 남아야 합니다.

IDiscount.IUpdate.description:
기존 할인 적용 내역(IDiscount)의 수정 요청/변경 입력 타입입니다.

- 실제 amount(금액) 변경은 엄격한 예외 플로우(감사·수동정정·AI 후보정 등)만 허용.
- notes 칼럼은 관리적·감사 목적 또는 에이전시 액션 처리 등에만 수정 가능합니다.
- 불변 필드(ID, discount_rule_id, order_id, applied_at)는 절대 변경 불가입니다.

운영 환경에서 감사 용도나 이상탐지 결과 수동 조치에 주로 활용됩니다.

oneOf.description:
캠페인 단위로 할인 룰 검색 시(연관 campaign 필터)

특정 마케팅이나 이벤트에 딸린 할인 룰만 추려낼 때 사용합니다. 없을 시 모든 룰 검색.

campaign_id.description:
캠페인 단위로 할인 룰 검색 시(연관 campaign 필터)

특정 마케팅이나 이벤트에 딸린 할인 룰만 추려낼 때 사용합니다. 없을 시 모든 룰 검색.

oneOf.description:
룰 종류(percentage, fixed, ML-driven 등) 문자열 필터.

이 값으로 다양한 할인 유형(rule type) 기반 분류·검색이 가능합니다.

type.description:
룰 종류(percentage, fixed, ML-driven 등) 문자열 필터.

이 값으로 다양한 할인 유형(rule type) 기반 분류·검색이 가능합니다.

oneOf.description:
활성화/비활성화 룰 여부 필터.

true면 현재 적용 가능, false면 과거 불가/비활성 룰만 조회. Any/무관이면 null.

active.description:
활성화/비활성화 룰 여부 필터.

true면 현재 적용 가능, false면 과거 불가/비활성 룰만 조회. Any/무관이면 null.

oneOf.description:
생성일(DateTime) 범위에 대한 쿼리용 배열. ['2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-01-31T23:59:59Z'] 등 2요소로 필터링 함.

날짜 구간 검색이 필요한 경우 사용.

created_at_range.description:
생성일(DateTime) 범위에 대한 쿼리용 배열. ['2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2025-01-31T23:59:59Z'] 등 2요소로 필터링 함.

날짜 구간 검색이 필요한 경우 사용.

IDiscountRule.IRequest.description:
할인 룰 목록 조회 시(body 기반) 필터/검색 조건 전달용 타입입니다.

- campaign_id, type, active 등은 디스카운트 정책 관리 패널, 정산, 감사 등에 직접 사용됩니다.
- created_at_range는 규제/정산/이상탐지 등 특정 이벤트 기간별 검색에 활용됩니다.

pagination.description: 페이지 정보 제공(현재 페이지, 전체 레코드, 전체 페이지 등)

data.description: 할인 룰(`discount_rules`) 엔티티 배열. 한 페이지에 해당하는 모든 룰 레코드 포함.

IPageIDiscountRule.description:
할인 룰 리스트/검색 결과에 페이징 메타데이터가 포함된 응답 컨테이너입니다.

모니터링, 정책 관리, 감사 패널 등에서 여러 번 호출되며, 한 페이지 단위로 이 리스트의 룰·페이징정보가 반환됩니다.

id.description: 할인 룰의 유일 식별자(Primary key).

oneOf.description: 해당 룰이 속해 있는 캠페인의 참조(ID).

campaign_id.description: 해당 룰이 속해 있는 캠페인의 참조(ID).

value.description: 할인 계산에 사용되는 코어 수치(퍼센트/고정/AI적용 등).

active.description: 해당 할인룰의 활성화(적용 가능) 여부. false면 과거 이력·감사 용도만 사용.

created_at.description: 룰 레코드 생성시각(불변증거)

oneOf.description: AI/ML 할인 적용 시 해당 모델 버전(@ref ai_model_versions.id) 참조. 일반 고정 정책은 null.

ai_model_version_id.description: AI/ML 할인 적용 시 해당 모델 버전(@ref ai_model_versions.id) 참조. 일반 고정 정책은 null.

IDiscountRule.description:
할인 룰 개별 객체(`discount_rules`)

- 캠페인, 할인 방식(type), 금액/비율 값, 활성 상태, AI모델 등과 연결되는 정책 기록
- 컴플라이언스·트러블슈팅·동적 가격 정책 관리 등 여러 엔터프라이즈 백엔드에서 핵심 기준
- 모든 필드는 Prisma DB 컬럼 주석에 따라 문서화/정의

oneOf.description:
할인 룰이 속할 캠페인의 UUID입니다. (선택사항)

대규모 마케팅, 시즌 이벤트, 혹은 특정 정책 묶음 단위에 바인딩 시 필요.

campaign_id.description:
할인 룰이 속할 캠페인의 UUID입니다. (선택사항)

대규모 마케팅, 시즌 이벤트, 혹은 특정 정책 묶음 단위에 바인딩 시 필요.

type.description:
할인 룰의 적용 방식(필수, 예시: 'percentage', 'fixed', 'ML-driven')

정책 생성시 항상 지정하며, 정책 룰 관리·AI연동 등에서 강제.

value.description: 룰의 수치 값(고정할인: -1000, 퍼센트: 15, AI모델: 예측값)

active.description: 등록시 활성 상태(적용 가능 여부). 최초 등록시 true가 대부분이나 과거 정책 이관 등 예외도 있음.

oneOf.description: AI/ML 기반 할인정책 적용 시 사용되는 모델 버전의 식별자(UUID). 고정/정적 룰이면 null.

ai_model_version_id.description: AI/ML 기반 할인정책 적용 시 사용되는 모델 버전의 식별자(UUID). 고정/정적 룰이면 null.

IDiscountRule.ICreate.description:
새로운 할인 룰을 등록(POST)할 때 사용하는 입력 타입입니다.

- 캠페인, 정책 방침(타입), 값(금액/비율), 활성화유무, AI 정책 적용여부 등 Prisma 설계와 동치
- 필드를 명확히 분리하여 비즈니스/AI 정책 확장 및 감사 적용 용이하게 설계합니다.

oneOf.description: 할인 룰이 속할 캠페인 UUID를 수정(매핑·이관·변경)할 때 사용

campaign_id.description: 할인 룰이 속할 캠페인 UUID를 수정(매핑·이관·변경)할 때 사용

value.description: 할인 정책 값(고정값, 퍼센트 등). 정책 변경, 관리자 조정, AI 예측 재조정 시 사용

active.description: 해당 룰의 활성화 변경 플래그. 정책 종료, 감사, 보안 대응 등 다양한 시점에 상태 갱신.

oneOf.description: AI/ML 모델 기반 할인 적용 정책 전환/교체 시 변경하는 FK 레퍼런스

ai_model_version_id.description: AI/ML 모델 기반 할인 적용 정책 전환/교체 시 변경하는 FK 레퍼런스

IDiscountRule.IUpdate.description:
등록된 할인 룰에 대한 속성 변경(수정) 입력 타입입니다.

- 캠페인 재매핑, 값/정책 변경, 활성화(on/off) 플래그, AI모델 정책 전환 등 변경에 활용
- type, created_at(증거 데이터)은 불변이며, value/active/ai_model_version_id 변경만 허용됩니다.

oneOf.description:
캠페인명에 대한 부분검색(대소문자, Trgm 인덱스 기반 등)

회계, 마케팅, 통계 등 다양한 캠페인 단위별 관리·조회에 활용

name.description:
캠페인명에 대한 부분검색(대소문자, Trgm 인덱스 기반 등)

회계, 마케팅, 통계 등 다양한 캠페인 단위별 관리·조회에 활용

oneOf.description:
캠페인 활성여부 필터(활성화/종료상태별 구분),

true면 현재 진행 중 캠페인만 필터, false면 과거 내역/종료 캠페인만.

active.description:
캠페인 활성여부 필터(활성화/종료상태별 구분),

true면 현재 진행 중 캠페인만 필터, false면 과거 내역/종료 캠페인만.

oneOf.description: 생성일(DateTime) 범위별 캠페인 검색용 조건

IDiscountCampaign.IRequest.description:
할인 캠페인(`discount_campaigns`) 리스트/검색 요청시, 페이징·조건 쿼리용 Request 타입

- 캠페인명·상태·시작/생성일 등 다양한 운영 조건에 활용
- 다양한 마케팅, 정산, 회계, 이벤트 관리 UI에서 리스트/검색 조건으로 전달

pagination.description: 페이지네이션 메타데이터(현재 페이지, 전체페이지, 전체 레코드 등)

data.description: 할인 캠페인(`discount_campaigns`) 객체 리스트

IPageIDiscountCampaign.description:
할인 캠페인(`discount_campaigns`) 리스트 조회시, 페이징 결과 컨테이너 타입

- pagination(메타 정보) + data(실제 엔티티 리스트)로 구성
- 대시보드, 분석, 마케팅 자동화에서 공용 사용

id.description:
할인 캠페인 유일 식별자(ID)

모든 discount_campaigns 레코드의 프라이머리 키(UUID)

name.description:
캠페인명(고유, 대시보드/검색/분석 대상)

운영·회계·분석·BI 다양한 목적에 통일된 이름 기준 제공

oneOf.description:
캠페인에 대한 부연 설명/Remarks

마케터가 쓰는 비즈니스 주석, AI추천·정산 사유 기록 등

description.description:

IPageIAiTrainingData.description:
A paginated container for lists of AI training datasets.

This type represents the result of a search or listing operation for AI training data assets used in model training, as described in the requirements analysis for advanced AI and data operations. It contains both paging information (see IPage.IPagination) and a list of entries of type IAiTrainingData, each representing a single registered AI dataset. Used to return results to clients for analytics, compliance, and governance workflows.

Underlying data and evidence traces are preserved for each page of results, supporting regulatory reporting, system auditability, and explainability in machine learning processes.

Primary Key. Unique identifier for the AI training dataset. References ai_training_data.id in the AdvancedAI Prisma schema.

This field is evidence-grade and immutable.

version.description: Version identifier (e.g., 'v1', '202404'). Required to distinguish individual dataset versions for reproducibility, evidence trace, and compliance.

source_uri.description: URI to the immutable source dataset (e.g., S3, GCS, file path). Required for provenance, legal/regulatory audits, and supporting data reproducibility in ML.

schema_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the dataset schema used for integrity, provenance, and regulatory proof of structure. Aids in detecting dataset drift, tampering, or schema upgrades.

IAITrainingData.description:
AI Training Dataset entity. Represents a single immutable, evidence-traceable registry record for any dataset (internal or external) used in machine learning model training or retraining.

Complies with advanced regulatory, AI governance, and continuous learning requirements: all datasets registered here are uniquely versioned, cryptographically traceable (via schema_hash), and immutably reference their external source URI for non-repudiation.

Satisfies advanced requirements such as explainability (dataset provenance for audit), compliance (model retraining/reproducibility), and future AI-operations (dataset superset tracing). Business modules depend on this type for model operations, continuous learning, and regulatory reporting.

Each attribute is mapped directly to the 'ai_training_data' Prisma schema columns. Multicultural and accessibility support (e.g. i18n dataset names) is handled by higher modules.

NO inline sub-objects permitted—all nested object types must be $ref, in accordance with best OpenAPI practices and system mandate.

IPageIAIDecisionLog is a paginated container for lists of AI decision log records. 

This type conforms to the standardized evidence, search, and analytics requirements for advanced AI operations in commerce platforms. It presents a list of AI decision log objects, along with pagination metadata needed for scalable access, compliance monitoring, and traceability. 

Referenced from user queries for AI explainability, analytics, or audit pipelines, this container ensures best practices for extensibility, evidence chain preservation, and regulatory compliance.

See original IPage schema and documentation in requirements analysis for implementation context.

pagination.description:
Pagination metadata object.

Indicates page number, page limitations, record counts, and total page information. Referenced in all IPage containers for regulatory audit and evidence preservation.

data.description: List of AI decision log entries included on this page. Each element is a full decision log documented per explainability and evidence-trace requirements.

IAIDecisionLog.description:
AI decision log record documenting a single model inference, automated output, or business rule fired by an AI. 

Draws directly from ai_decision_logs table as described in Prisma schema and requirements. 

Records model version, target entity/user, result/rationale, input snapshot, and full evidence attributes to support regulatory compliance, forensic audit, explainability, and ML optimization. 

Evidence preservation is paramount; this object is returned in detail views and paged results, and acts as a canonical log for explainability requests.

Properties mirror the source DB schema and include compliance-oriented documentation for each field.

Maps to ai_decision_logs.id (UUID). Canonical reference for audit, evidence, or model feedback trace.

# AutoBE Generated Backend Server

![AutoBE Logo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a90d14be-fd50-4dc7-ae9d-ca66c2124f31)

A backend repository generated by [`@autobe`](https://github.com/wrtnlabs/autobe).

This backend program was automatically generated using [`@autobe`](https://github.com/wrtnlabs/autobe), the AI vibe coding agent for backend servers of below stack.

- TypeScript
- NestJS / Nestia
- Prisma
- Postgres

## Project Structure

This template project has categorized directories like below.

As you can see from the below, all of the Backend source files are placed into the [src](src/) directory. When you build the TypeScript source files, compiled files would be placed into the `lib` directory following the [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json) configuration. Otherwise you build client [SDK](#32-sdk) library for npm publishing and their compiled files would be placed into the [packages](packages) directory.

  - [packages/api/](packages/api): SDK module built by `npm run build:api`
  - [src/](src): Backend source directory
    - [src/api/](src/api/): Client SDK that would be published to the `@ORGANIZATION/PROJECT-api`
      - [**src/api/functional/**](src/api/functional/): API functions generated by the [`nestia`](https://github.com/samchon/nestia)
      - [**src/api/structures/**](src/api/structures/): DTO structures
    - [src/controllers/](src/controllers/): Controller classes of the Main Program
  - [**test/**](test): Test Automation Program
    - [test/features](test/features): List of test functions
  - [nestia.config.ts](nestia.config.ts): Configuration file of [`nestia`](https://github.com/samchon/nestia)
  - [package.json](package.json): NPM configuration
  - [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json): TypeScript configuration for the main program

## NPM Run Commands

List of the run commands defined in the [package.json](package.json) are like below:

  - Test
    - **`test`**: Run test automation program
    - `benchmark`: Run performance benchmark program
  - Build
    - `build`: Build everything
    - `build:main`: Build main program (`src` directory)
    - `build:test` Build test automation program (`test` directory)
    - `build:sdk`: Build SDK into main program only
    - `build:swagger`: Build Swagger Documents
    - **`dev`**: Incremental build for development (test program)
  - Deploy
    - `package:api`: Build and deploy the SDK library to the NPM
    - `start`: Start the backend server
    - `start:dev`: Start the backend server with incremental build and reload
  - Webpack
    - `webpack`: Run webpack bundler
    - `webpack:start`: Start the backend server built by webpack
    - `webpack:test`: Run test program to the webpack built

## Specialization

Transform this template project to be yours.

When you've created a new backend project through this template project, you can specialize it to be suitable for you by changing some words. Replace below words through IDE specific function like `Edit > Replace in Files` (*Ctrl + Shift + H*), who've been supported by the VSCode.

| Before       | After
|--------------|----------------------------------------
| ORGANIZATION | Your account or corporation name
| PROJECT      | Your own project name
| AUTHOR       | Author name
| https://github.com/samchon/nestia-start | Your repository URL

# SDK Library
This is a SDK library generated by [`nestia`](https://nestia.io).

With this SDK library, you can easily and safely interact with backend server.

Just import and call some API functions like gif image below:

![nestia-sdk-demo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13158709/215004990-368c589d-7101-404e-b81b-fbc936382f05.gif)

> Left is server code, and right is client code utilizing the SDK




# What [`Nestia`](https://nestia.io) is:
![Nestia Logo](https://nestia.io/logo.png)

[![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/samchon/nestia/blob/master/LICENSE)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@nestia/core.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nestia/core)
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@nestia/core.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nestia/core)
[![Build Status](https://github.com/samchon/nestia/workflows/build/badge.svg)](https://github.com/samchon/nestia/actions?query=workflow%3Abuild)
[![Guide Documents](https://img.shields.io/badge/guide-documents-forestgreen)](https://nestia.io/docs/)

Nestia is a set of helper libraries for NestJS, supporting below features:

  - `@nestia/core`: super-fast decorators
  - `@nestia/sdk`:
    - Swagger generator evolved than ever
    - SDK library generator for clients
    - Mockup Simulator for client applications
    - Automatic E2E test functions generator
  - `@nestia/migrate`: migration from Swagger to NestJS
  - `nestia`: just CLI (command line interface) tool

> **Note**
> 
> - **Only one line** required, with pure TypeScript type
> - Enhance performance **30x** up
>   - Runtime validator is **20,000x faster** than `class-validator`
>   - JSON serialization is **200x faster** than `class-transformer`
> - Software Development Kit
>   - SDK is a collection of `fetch` functions with type definitions like [tRPC](https://trpc.io/)
>   - Mockup simulator means embedded backend simulator in SDK
>     - similar with [msw](https://mswjs.io/), but fully automated
